description: Short explanation of a control, shown on focus or hover.

howToUse: Use it to name an icon button or explain a control in a few words, shown on hover and on focus.
Keep `label` short. Add `shortcut` when the action has one ("⌘K").
Turn on `portalled` when the tooltip is cut by a container with scroll.
Nothing in it can be clicked, and on touch screens it may never show: keep important information visible.
alternatives: Content with links or buttons: Popover.
A preview of a person or item on hover: HoverCard.
Help for a form field: HelpField.

keyboard.action: Focusing the control shows the tooltip; leaving hides it.
Hides the tooltip and keeps the focus.

props.name: portalled
props.description: Renders the bubble in body to escape containers with overflow.
